title: Issue #204: [P0] Define normative identity, compute-job, attestation, policy and transaction contracts
content:
State: open

## Goal
Turn the proposed interfaces in [the architecture specification](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/blob/docs/aurora-ecosystem-architecture-spec-v1/docs/architecture/AURORA_ECOSYSTEM_TECHNICAL_SPEC_V1.md#4-required-interfaces-and-proposed-contracts) into versioned normative contracts owned by `atc-standards`.

## Scope
- Define versioned schemas for agent identity/registration/revocation, compute job/run/worker lease, result attestation, policy decision and transaction correlation metadata.
- Specify canonical IDs, timestamps, nonce/freshness, expiry, error/status enums, compatibility and migration rules.
- Define the correctness assurance model for each job class; distinguish signer attribution from result correctness.
- State which repository owns each schema and how runtime implementations pin compatible versions.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each contract has a versioned machine-readable schema and normative semantics.
- [ ] Duplicate identity, expired/revoked credential, stale/replayed result and invalid policy decision cases are specified.
- [ ] Transaction flow separates proposal, wallet authorization/signature, execution candidate and finality.
- [ ] Positive and negative conformance tests are defined.
- [ ] Review/approval and exact commit SHA are recorded; downstream implementations can reference the version.

## Dependencies
None. This is a prerequisite for the lifecycle and multi-node implementation issues.

## Evidence
Link schema files, review record and test results tied to exact SHAs. Do not mark VERIFIED based on documentation presence alone.
